# quicknode_stream (Data Source)

An existing stream, looked up by `id`. Destination credentials are stored in Terraform state, so keep state encrypted and remote.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a stream created outside Terraform.
data "quicknode_stream" "transfers" {
  id = "0b4a6f8e-3c1d-4e2a-9f7b-5d6c8e1a2b3c"
}

# The last block the stream delivered. It moves while the stream runs.
output "transfers_sequence" {
  value = data.quicknode_stream.transfers.sequence
}

output "transfers_state" {
  value = data.quicknode_stream.transfers.status
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Stream id.

### Read-Only

- `dataset` (String) What each batch carries.
- `dataset_batch_size` (Number) Blocks per batch.
- `destination` (Attributes) Where the stream delivers. One type is set; the others are null. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--destination))
- `elastic_batch_enabled` (Boolean) Whether batches grow while the stream catches up.
- `end_range` (Number) Last block the stream delivers, or null if it runs until paused.
- `extra_destinations` (Attributes List) More destinations that receive every batch, or null if there are none. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--extra_destinations))
- `filter_function` (String) Source code of the filter, or null if the stream has none.
- `filter_language` (String) `javascript` or `go`.
- `fix_block_reorgs` (Boolean) Whether corrected blocks are delivered when the network reorganizes.
- `keep_distance_from_tip` (Number) How many blocks the stream stays behind the newest block.
- `name` (String) Name shown in the dashboard.
- `network` (String) Network slug.
- `notification_email` (String) Address notified when the stream is terminated, or null.
- `region` (String) Region the stream runs in.
- `restream_batch_on_reorg` (Boolean) Whether the whole batch is delivered again when a block in it is reorganized.
- `sequence` (Number) Last block delivered. It moves while the stream runs.
- `start_range` (Number) First block the stream delivers.
- `status` (String) `active`, `paused`, `terminated` or `completed`.
